turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have until then, Hale. On what basis?
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. Now tell me what you have.
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.
The zero comes off today; I'm writing that down. Now explain why Owen is rewriting anything when you still haven't shown me a single reason he should.
Here it is in writing, signed.

I'm reading every line of it before I say anything. Withdrawn today, the rewrite private and at lunch, nothing on his record, your signature. That's the terms, Hale, not a reason; why is there a rewrite at all?
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
I'm not done, and I'm still sitting down. You haven't answered my question: on what basis does Owen rewrite anything?
Then I'm going to the principal's office next, with this signed page in my hand. You'll have my position in writing tonight, and I'll want an answer on that rewrite by the end of tomorrow, Hale.
